name: City Council Regular Meeting - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 13, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. The Public may join this meeting virtually or
 attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81532744092
  Webinar ID: 815 3274 4092
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81532744092# OR +16699009128,,81532744092#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468 OR +1 253 215 8782

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of July 26, 2023 Regular City Council Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Presentation from Las Virgenes Water District on the Water Line Breaks at
  Lindero Canyon Road and Agoura Road

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page
1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior
to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING: CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-005; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2316-23 - Adopt Resolution No. 2316-23, determining Conditional Use Permit
  No. 23-005 is exempt from CEQA and approving Conditional Use Permit No. 23-
  005 to authorize the sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for onsite and offsite
  consumption in conjunction with the operation of a new restaurant located in Suites
  601 and 602 of the Lindero Oaks commercial center at 31149 Via Colinas.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2316-23 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-005 TO AUTHORIZE
  THE SALE OF BEER, WINE, AND DISTILLED SPIRITS FOR ONSITE AND OFFSITE
  CONSUMPTION IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE OPERATION OF A NEW RESTAURANT
  LOCATED AT 31149 VIA COLINAS, SUITES 601 & 602

2.  PUBLIC HEARING: CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 23-003 - City Council
  direct staff to prepare a resolution for City Council consideration to (approve or
  deny) Conditional Use Permit No. 23-003.
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective August 1, 2023 in the amount
  of $ 702,961.41; August 15, 2023 in the amount of $ 555,553.73; September 1,
  2023 in the amount of $ 486,966.32.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. PUBLIC SAFETY ADVISORY BOARD APPOINTMENTS - Appoint to the
  Public Safety Advisory Board, Shirley Richards for a term ending March 31,
  2025 and Alison Colburn, Lisa Gritzner, Constance Kamsler, Mary-Ann Parker
  and Richard “Tex” Williams for terms ending March 31, 2026.

  2. ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 304-23. ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO UPDATE SIGN
  REGULATIONS AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION
  - Waive the Second Reading and adopt Ordinance No. 304-23.

  ORDINANCE NO. 304-23 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO UPDATE SIGN
  REGULATIONS AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  AWARD OF CONTRACTS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 SIDEWALK
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AND THE LINDERO CANYON ROAD PARKWAY
  LANDSCAPE IMPROVEMENT PROJECT AND APPROVAL OF NOTICE OF
  EXEMPTION DETERMINATION - Approve staff’s finding of a CEQA categorical
  exemption; award a construction contract for the FY 2023-24 Sidewalk
  Improvement Project to DASH Construction Company Inc. in the amount of
  $689,240.00; award a construction contract for the Lindero Canyon Road Parkway
  Landscape Improvement Project to Marina Landscape Inc. in the amount of
  $142,868.80; approve project management and construction inspection
  expenditures, authorize the City Manager or designee to approve construction
  change orders up to the contingency amount; approve continuing appropriations
  from the FY 2022-23 budget as detailed above and authorize the Mayor to sign
  and execute the construction contracts on behalf of the City.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  COMMENT LETTERS ON THOUSAND OAKS 2045 GENERAL PLAN AND
  DRAFT ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT - City Council provide input
  regarding the City’s comment letters on the Thousand Oaks 2045 General Plan
  and DEIR.
 2.  APPROVAL OF THE CONTRACT AGREEMENT BETWEEN FLOCK
  GROUP INC. DBA FLOCK SAFETY AND THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE FOR AUTOMATED LICENSE PLATE READER CAMERAS -
  Approve an agreement with Flock Group Inc. for leasing 17 Automated License
  Plate Reader cameras to be placed throughout the City and authorize the Mayor
  to sign and execute the agreement on behalf of the City.

3.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO NEWBURY PARK TREE SERVICES FOR ON-
  CALL MAINTENANCE AND EMERGENCY TREE SERVICES - Award Newbury
  Park Tree Service, Inc. an on-call maintenance and emergency tree services
  contract and authorize the Mayor to sign this service contract on behalf of the City.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, September 7, 2023 at 6:15 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.
